0.original: Eilis would call you to the wall once more.

1.original: Eilis has briefed you on the need to divert Sahagin forces away from South Tidegate. Speak with Nortmoen about the tactical situation.

2.original: Nortmoen outlines a simple plan: slay a pair of trenchtooth Sahagin.

3.original: Apprise Eilis of the situation in the north.

4.original: Eilis reports that the decoy attack was a success, and that the detachment returned safely through the southern gates without ado.

49.original: We would open South Tidegate to welcome a returning detachment, but doing so would expose us to the Sahagin.

50.original: Thus, we aim to launch a diversionary attack along the north side and lure the Sahagin hordes away from the open gate.

51.original: Seek out Nortmoen at North Tidegate─the offensive falls under his command.

52.original: So you've come to help bail my beleaguered brother out from under trouble's foot once more? Very well. All you need do is slay a pair of the skittish little sea slugs─that ought to summon the lot of them.

55.original: Sure as rain, our subtle stratagem drew the southerly sea-sods away from the open gates. The men of the detachment send their gratitude.
